title: P4 browser and export acceptance refresh
scope: Public checkout code and web assets were exercised against receipt-bound private Freddie sample data. No raw data or private workspace paths are included in this public evidence summary.

provenance_checks: Seven downloadable JSON report families retain exact report-payload parity after removing the export envelope.
Each source import carries receipt/output hashes and 39/39 relative upstream lineage path/hash pairs.
Derived artifact receipt hashes are checked for scenario, ECL, tail, movement, and convergence exports; portfolio review is checked against its saved revision and snapshots.
Private and no-public-release flags are preserved; no absolute workspace path is exported.

focused_tests.scope: HTTP boundary, P4 exposure views/convergence, and portfolio review tests against public code with the pinned project environment.
focused_tests.skip_reason: The public checkout does not contain the private evidence required by five tests.

decision_boundary: This acceptance verifies application behavior and local byte lineage; it does not authenticate Freddie Mac as publisher of the local archive or establish applicable terms or redistribution rights.
The Freddie input remains sample-level UPB, not an owned portfolio, borrower concentration, EAD, calibrated PD/LGD, or empirical ECL.
Native Microsoft Excel desktop review, Apple issuer-panel KPI-period trace, and overall N02 source-to-KPI acceptance remain open.

full_public_suite.environment: Project-pinned Python 3.12.14; PYTHONPATH=src; dedicated writable test temp directory on D:
full_public_suite.skip_reason: Declared tests require private source data or machine-local evidence excluded from the public bundle.
